<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—a series of peaks spaced ~1 Da with intensities decreasing roughly by a factor of ten (≈11 % for M+1, ≈1 % for M+2, etc.)—the pattern matches the natural 13C isotopic distribution. No other element shows its characteristic pattern (e.g., Cl, Br, S). Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
